newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish bonds easier, weaker markka hits short end.
newsitem.headline: Finnish bonds easier, weaker markka hits short end.

text.p: Bonds eased in calm trade on Friday, closely tracking German bunds, and investors were seen remaining cautious, dealers said.
Long-maturity yields were off highs, with the spread over Germany steady at about 47 basis points, but short-end bond and FRA yields were sharply higher reflecting markka volatility, dealers said.
The markka hovered at weaker levels around 3.02 versus the German mark after a sharp slide was halted by central bank intervention, but jitters continued, forex dealers said.
"All the ingredients for further volatility exist," one forex dealer said.
"There is a lot of liquidity in this market," he added.
